senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; עָרַךְ)arrangement, order, esp. pile of wood on the altar in the Temple.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 33a:7">Yoma 33ᵃ</cite> <he>אביי מסדר מ׳</he> … <he>מ׳ גדולה וכ׳</he> Abbayi related the order of the priestly functions in behalf of the college … as follows: the large pile comes before &c.
